title: Align the declared Node runtime with the bundled c8 toolchain
goal: Make the supported runtime contract match the test and coverage dependencies users actually install.
in_scope: Update README runtime prerequisites to the same supported range
Add a manifest regression test that compares the declared engine with c8 12's supported range
Verify tests, doctor, coverage, and installer dry runs on the active supported runtime
out_of_scope: Pinning an older c8 solely to retain Node 18/19
acceptance: package.json and README declare a Node engine range compatible with c8 12 (^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || >=23), strict-engine installation rejects unsupported Node 18/19 before tool execution, and supported runtimes can install and run the test and coverage commands without engine conflicts.
invariants: Documentation and package metadata advertise the same runtime support
The bundled development toolchain has no engine range broader than the package contract
Runtime alignment does not change Throughline's platform-neutral state contract
